integrated.cardAria: Combined multisport training status and 28-day load focus
integrated.title: Combined multisport status
integrated.authoritativeSource: Server-computed combined CTL · ATL · TSB across cycling, running, and swimming
integrated.contributionBasis: Current CTL contributions describe the accumulated training load by sport. They are not recommended proportions for future training.
integrated.noContributionData: No fitness contribution data by sport
integrated.focusUnavailable: Load focus is unavailable because it is not provided by the canonical server data.
integrated.focusBarAria: Load focus for the last {{days}} days: {{values}}
integrated.focusBasis: With at least 50% zone coverage, each activity load is allocated once by zone time weighted by representative intensity squared; otherwise it stays unclassified.
integrated.anaerobicBikeDetail: Measured cycling power Z6–Z7 is included as high intensity and can support anaerobic cycling detail.
integrated.hrHighIntensityNote: HR Z5 is high-intensity evidence, not proof of anaerobic contribution.

sport.insufficient: Not enough measured evidence · not scored
sport.scoreGuide: A 100-point ability score simplified from your personal PDC over the last 90 days.

bike.title: Cycling ability evidence
bike.basis: Three separate axes from the last 90-day measured PDC · {{count}} activities · personal power profile summarized on a 100-point scale
bike.notGarmin: The calculation differs from Garmin. Garmin uses proprietary metrics such as EPOC and Training Effect; O-Rider explains your personal ability using published PDC evidence.
bike.manualLink: How PDC and the three axes are calculated

run.title: Running evidence
run.basis: Record times remain hidden until their source is verified.
run.noQualifiedEvidence: No source-qualified distance records are available.
run.unverifiedBasis: Review the sport and records in the source activities.

swim.title: Swimming evidence
swim.basis: Configured CSS and measured swim efficiency from the last {{days}} days only; no mock curve or invented PR.

abilityScore.guide: A fixed five-level score summarizing your personal PDC analysis, not a ranking or percentile among users.

snapshot.title: Current fitness snapshot
snapshot.subtitle: Read each value together with its evaluation and basis
snapshot.ftpSource: W/kg calculated from current profile FTP and weight
snapshot.ftpWeightMissing: Profile FTP · W/kg unavailable without body weight
snapshot.riderSource: Last 90-day PDC · Coggan men's power profile (v1); sex and age are not adjusted
snapshot.vo2PdcSource: Estimated from CP/5-minute power and weight in the last 90-day PDC · {{count}} activities · not a lab measurement
snapshot.vo2FormulaSource: Simple estimate from profile FTP and weight · not a lab measurement
snapshot.loadSource: CTL 42-day EMA · ATL 7-day EMA · TSB=CTL-ATL. This is not Garmin acute load

performance.title: Cycling Performance
performance.canonical: Profile source of truth · applied to zones and training
performance.ftpMissingEvidence: There is no active profile FTP, so W/kg and the FTP difference are not calculated.
performance.modelEvidence: eFTP uses 95% of the monthly best 20-minute average power; CP and TTE come from the last 90-day PDC model. All are estimates and never change active FTP automatically.

mobileFitness.zoneSourcePowerHistorical: Z1–Z7 combined using each activity’s FTP · not reclassified with current FTP. Includes only activities with complete zone evidence.

weeklyEvidence.noKnownWeeks: No weeks in this range have a known load, so an average or peak is not calculated.
weeklyEvidence.timeInput: Reflected duration {{minutes}} min ÷ 60 × hourly factor {{factor}} (rounded after calculation)
weeklyEvidence.averageHelp: The known load total {{total}} across {{count}} weeks is divided by {{count}} and rounded to {{value}}. Unknown weeks are excluded from the {{weeks}}-week denominator; weeks with partial or estimated totals remain included.
weeklyEvidence.peakHelp: The largest displayed total among {{count}} known weeks is {{value}} ({{weeks}}). Stored/server and estimated loads may be included; unknown weeks are excluded.
weeklyEvidence.trendHelp: Compares the previous week {{previous}} with the current week {{current}}. A trend is reported only when both displayed totals are available and contain no estimates or unknown activities.
